summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream API documentation establishes access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, retain history, send alerts, use images/trademarks/prices, or monetize. Current compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. No go-live proposal is supported. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate, advertising, public-display, or alert-expansion decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable because evidence is partial. Progress consists of official API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy artifacts. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted caching, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor terms/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Compliance and claims triage: retain cookie and analytics disclosures, consent and withdrawal behavior, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, provenance and rights records, copyright and trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where supported by site evidence. Do not infer adult or regulated status from domain names. Analytics permission errors and yellow freshness/coverage status remain unknown rather than zero; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and a completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization. Retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only; do not create new production work, monetization, tracking, or launch proposals.
